title: Codex ratings must use the trace ID actually stamped on gateway requests
answers: A Slack rating on a Codex answer points at nothing
Codex generations appear in separate traces
How should the agent-server resolve a turn's trace ID?
Can Claude use the run ID as its trace ID?
body:
Symptom: A Slack rating on a Codex answer cannot open the turn, and each generation appears in a separate trace.
Root cause: Requests lacked a shared trace header and turn results lacked a matching fallback; these concerns are handled by products/desktop/packages/agent/src/server/agent-server.ts:AgentServer.configureEnvironment and AgentServer.turnTraceId.
Fix pattern: Stamp X-PostHog-Trace-Id with the Codex run ID, derive the fallback from the actual configured header, and propagate that same ID through rating-facing results and turn-complete events. Preserve an adapter-reported string trace ID.
Constraints: Stamp only Codex runs with a taskRunId on the authenticated Go gateway path. Without AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN, the Python gateway fallback carries no stamp, so adapter type alone cannot justify a run-ID fallback. Reset the stored fallback on reinitialization. Never stamp Claude: this header outranks traceparent and would collapse its per-turn traces into one run trace.
applies: Agent-server gateway configuration and trace IDs exposed to Slack ratings or turn-complete consumers.
